patch_evidence.details: Wraps session webRequest.onBeforeSendHeaders and tags Anthropic/Claude domain requests with x-reclaude-profile.
Filters selected proxy/certificate switches from process.argv and wraps app.commandLine.hasSwitch while preserving native Chromium behavior.
Stages the CA and wraps two actual VM spawn callsites with a read-only CA mount and guest environment.
This flag permits a CLAUDE_AI_URL override; it does not itself change the frontend URL.

limitations: Function names were recovered from Go pclntab. Some decompiled C has Go ABI variable-allocation warnings; framing and signing claims were checked against assembly and data references.
The archive and binary are not included. Addresses and offsets apply only to the identified samples.
No claim is made about remote gateway implementation, credential ownership, successful inference, or compatibility with newer official Desktop builds.
No credentials, account binding IDs, private inference URLs, user transcripts or raw logs are included.
